key_insight: A commutativity-aware hypergraph representation accelerates quantum circuit template matching by preserving local connectivity.
engineering_relevance: Faster template matching can reduce quantum circuit optimization time without sacrificing optimization quality on the evaluated benchmarks.
method: Collapse commuting gates into single hypergraph super-nodes.
Preserve circuit connectivity to extend matches locally.
Restrict incremental updates to the immediate neighborhood.
evidence_signal: On random and arithmetic benchmarks, the HG matcher achieved 11–606× speedups over Qiskit's DAG-based implementation with the same optimization quality; acceleration increased with circuit size.
watch_item: Performance beyond the tested benchmark families and the overhead of constructing the hypergraph require further evaluation.
paper_title: Fast Template Matching for Quantum Circuits Using Hypergraph
